title: brachiaria obtusa
intro: Brachiaria obtusa, commonly known as "Tambaqui grass" or "Kanikkam", is a type of grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Brachiaria obtusa include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Brachiaria obtusa are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a potential candidate for the development of new medicines and therapies.
